text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today marks the start of a long and arduous journey in the Twinkle Series for me and my trainee. Her name is…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My name is Satono Diamond. It's nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: One day, I will shine as brilliantly as a diamond and make history by breaking the Satono family's jinx… That is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As such, I'm counting on you to work with me on turning my dream into a reality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begin my days challenging the Twinkle Series with <chrname>!
